basis.trees: docs/world-building/TREE_BIRDS_NOW.txt (66 pool ids, nests, current bands)
basis.rules: docs/world-building/SAPLING_BIRDS.md (one line per sapling); the owner 2026-10-21: 'for each sapling around give it a unique as possible spawn, not like pidove or trumbeak'
basis.area_check: data/spawns.json surface.<subregion>.* , habitat.* and fishing.* ids, grepped 2026-10-21 at 27878f03. 'in area' in a why means the species or its family already spawns in the tree's own subregion.
basis.tree_town_canopy: The reserved grove-giant pool (sewaddle, aipom, pikipek, emolga, pachirisu, applin, combee, cutiefly) sits in the Foothill woods, so none of those lines is put on a Foothill grove or woods tree.

conventions.line: The full evolutionary line, base first; branches listed in order (wurmple: silcoon>beautifly, cascoon>dustox).
conventions.bands: low = ground+12 nest, mid = ground+35 (and +58 on an elder), crown = the top nest. An evolved stage is placed only in the crown, and only where its level evolution is at or under the band's top; it then spawns from its evolution level to the band's top.
conventions.levels: The tree's current band, unchanged. crown_levels is kept only where the tree already had a higher crown band (two trees).
conventions.evolution_levels: Mainline values, ASSUMED: not read from the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar in this pass. Item, trade, friendship and move evolutions are never placed.

elder_foothill_grove_1.why: Kept: the sun-staring bird under the world tree; Xatu 25 is over the band, and this tree stays the Koga answer (levels into Xatu under cap 40).

elder_foothill_grove_2.why: Fruit Pokemon round the world tree's elders; Steenee 18 fits, Tsareena (move) not placed. Not in Foothill (Steenee only on Long Isle south).

elder_foothill_grove_3.why: Fireflies lighting the grove at dusk under the world tree. Not in Foothill; Lake Viltri hollow next door has it in its roster.

elder_foothill_grove_4.why: Kept: cloud wings at the foot of a tree whose crown is in the clouds; now the only Swablu tree (was four). Altaria 35 over band.

elder_foothill_woods_1.why: A troop of treetop monkeys in the region's biggest wood (Dex: lives in groups in the treetops). Primeape 28 over band. Not in Foothill.

elder_foothill_woods_2.why: Thread-ball spiders strung between the oak limbs; Spidops 15 fits. New to the map's trees (Spidops only at Glacier's foot).

elder_foothill_woods_3.why: A hornet tree under the Tri Peaks: cocoons on the limbs, Beedrill in the crown (7, 10 fit). Bug/Poison quarter-resists Grass: an Erika answer on leg 3. Not in Foothill.

elder_foothill_woods_4.why: Kept: a ladybird swarm on an oak; Ledian 18 fits. In no roster anywhere else.

elder_jungle_east_1.why: Kept: the wrestler diving from the canopy. The tree now stands on Long Isle south, whose roster lacks it (jungle_east's has it).

elder_jungle_east_2.why: Tail-handed monkeys swinging through the jungle edge; Ambipom (move) not placed. Not in Long Isle south (in jungle_west and the reserved Tree Town pool).

elder_jungle_west_1.why: Kept: the banana-necked flyer in the emergent canopy. Not in Long Isle south (in jungle_west, Tilpey east, Old Orchard).

elder_jungle_west_2.why: A berry-throwing troop on the isle's high ground; the crown keeps Toucannon's 30-34. In no roster on the map. Pairs in lore with Oranguru on Long Isle south 2.

elder_lake_viltri_hollow_1.why: Water-bubble spiders on the riparian oak's lake side; Araquanid 22 over band. Not in the hollow (River of Shrews vale, Foothill fishing).

elder_lake_viltri_hollow_2.why: Kept: dragonflies over the lake, the most visible elder on leg 2; Yanmega (move) not placed. Now the only Yanma tree.

elder_long_isle_middle_1.why: Paint-tagging tree climbers marking the mossy wood's trunks; Grafaiai 28 fits. Not on Long Isle (Grafaiai only in jungle_east).

elder_long_isle_middle_2.why: Moths drawn to the dark mossy wood; Venomoth 31 fits. Not on Long Isle.

elder_long_isle_north_1.why: Storm petrels on a coastal spruce, replacing the Wingull line; Kilowattrel 25 fits. Not on Long Isle (West shore, South strand, Tilpey east, Route 8).

elder_long_isle_north_2.why: A bat roost on a far coast; Noivern 48 fits the crown at 48-50. Not on Long Isle (the Crags, Fungal south). Replaces the rare Corviknight.

elder_long_isle_south_1.why: Kept: the mimic bird on the jungle edge. Not in Long Isle south's roster (jungle_east, Tri Peaks).

elder_long_isle_south_2.why: A leaf monkey sharing the canopy; Simisage (Leaf Stone) not placed. In no roster. Replaces Squawkabilly, which Long Isle south's own roster already gives.

elder_long_isle_south_3.why: The treetop sage on the highest, most remote elder on the map. In no roster. Oricorio moves to the Sunset east palm, its warm-isle home.

elder_marshy_marsh_1.why: Pond skaters on the mangrove pools, eyespot moths in the crown; Masquerain 22 fits. Not in the marsh. Flamigo moves to the Tilpey south lakeshore tree.

elder_marshy_marsh_2.why: Kept: the Dark/Flying Sabrina answer near leg 6. In no roster elsewhere.

elder_marshy_marsh_3.why: Kept: fishes the drowned swamp; a Water/Flying Blaine answer. Not in the marsh (Shrew Lakes, Tilpey waters).

elder_north_pine_isle_1.why: Frost larvae clinging to snow-loaded pine limbs; Frosmoth (friendship, night) not placed. Not on North Pine (South Pine, the troughs, Frostpeak strand).

elder_north_pine_isle_2.why: Bats wintering in the pine's hollows; Golbat 22 fits, Crobat (friendship) not placed. No wild Zubat anywhere on the map (Golbat only in Wedge south).

elder_northgate_east_1.why: Root-dwelling nymphs at the trunk, Ninjask buzzing the crown; 20 fits, Shedinja (special) not placed. Not on Northgate.

elder_northgate_east_2.why: Electric squirrels in a northern spruce (its Sinnoh home). Not on Northgate (Foothill roster, Tree Town reserve).

elder_northgate_west_1.why: Bark-chewing larvae and battery pupae in the thicket; Charjabug 20 fits, Vikavolt (item/location) not placed. In no roster on the map.

elder_northgate_west_2.why: Lantern spirits glowing in a dark spruce thicket; Gourgeist (trade) not placed. Not on Northgate (Wedge north, Fungal south). Its trade partner Phantump is in Northgate west's roster.

elder_peak_pond_hollow_1.why: Bagworms hanging like cones in old-growth spruce; Forretress 31 fits the crown at 31-32. Bug/Steel resists Grass and is immune to Poison: Erika and Koga answer, 68 off leg 4. Not at Peak Pond.

elder_peak_pond_hollow_2.why: Cloaked bagworms on the limbs, Mothim in the crown; 20 fits. Replaces Fletchinder's Erika role with a Bug/Flying. In no roster on the map.

elder_peak_pond_hollow_3.why: Squirrels hoarding cones up the trunk; Greedent 24 fits. Not at Peak Pond (Viltri's Path, Route 1 maze, Greedent at Tilpey east).

elder_shrew_lake_shores_1.why: Pollen flies working the blossom; Ribombee 25 over band. Not in the Shrew vale (Arrow Lake, Tilpey west, Long Isle south, Tree Town reserve).

elder_shrew_lake_shores_2.why: Kept: bees at the blossom; Vespiquen 21 over band. Not in the vale (Route 1 maze).

elder_shrew_lake_shores_3.why: Kept: seeds drifting round the blossom; Skiploom 18 over band. Not in the vale (Pallet meadows).

elder_south_pine_isle_1.why: The egg thief that climbs trees to raid nests: right on a nest tree. Weavile (Razor Claw, night) not placed. Not on South Pine (North Pine, Frostpeak, the troughs).

elder_south_pine_isle_2.why: Frosted webs in a snow pine; Ariados 22 fits. Not on South Pine (Fungal south, Route 1 maze, Northgate west, jungle_east).

elder_south_pine_isle_3.why: Kept unchanged, the one owl line left: the owl isle's grown owl as the crown rare. IN AREA: South Pine's roster has Dartrix and Decidueye.

elder_tilpey_east_shore_1.why: Sloths hanging from the lakeside oaks, the whole line (18, 36 fit). Replaces the owl. Not at Tilpey (Slaking only in jungle_west).

elder_tilpey_north_shore_1.why: Kept: the tree the owner called 'way better'; now the only Ducklett tree. IN AREA: Tilpey north's roster has Ducklett and Swanna.

elder_tilpey_north_shore_2.why: Balloons snagged in the birch crown; Drifblim 28 fits. Ghost/Flying takes over Staraptor's Ground-immune Giovanni role. Not at Tilpey (Drifblim in the Wedge).

elder_viltri_plateau_1.why: The first elder most players see: a full butterfly line, Vivillon wings in the crown (9, 12 fit). Not on the plateau.

elder_viltri_plateau_2.why: Cocoons hung on birch limbs, both branches grown in the crown (7, 10 fit). Not on the plateau (Route 1 maze, Foothill).

elder_viltri_plateau_3.why: Acorns hanging from branches, Nuzleaf 14 in the crown; Shiftry (Leaf Stone) not placed. Not on the plateau (River of Shrews vale).

elder_viltris_path_valley_1.why: Kanto's butterfly grown in the far valley (7, 10 fit). Not in the valley (plateau, Pallet, Route 1 maze).

elder_viltris_path_valley_2.why: Kept: the leek bird in the reeds, the map's first 'find'. Not in the valley (North shore downs).

elder_wedge_north_1.why: Kept: crows in the ghost wood, a Sabrina answer; now the only Murkrow tree (was two). Honchkrow (Dusk Stone) not placed. Not in Wedge north's roster today.

elder_wedge_north_2.why: Stump spirits in the dark wood, Ghost for Sabrina; Trevenant (trade) not placed. Not in Wedge north; Wedge south's heart is Trevenant.

elder_wedge_south_2.why: Glowing mushrooms up a dead dark-oak trunk; Shiinotic 24 fits. Not in the Wedge (Fungal north).

sapling_frost_glacier_foot_fields.why: The Frost Tree Pokemon round a frost tree; Abomasnow 40 over band. Not at the Glacier's foot.

sapling_lakeshore_arrow_lake_shores.why: Lily-pad Pokemon in the skin's own lily pads; Lombre 14 fits, Ludicolo (Water Stone) not placed. Not at Arrow Lake (Lake Viltri hollow, fishing).

sapling_storm_rift_trunk.why: Kept: the electric glider under the standing storm. Not in the Rift trunk's roster (Peak Pond, Tree Town reserve).
